solution_summary: In 2019, Microsoft used 16 different case management tools, which made collaboration across various lines of business difficult. In 2020, the company started to shift its customer care platform to as part of a larger commitment to support customer service and support agents. Microsoft rolled out Microsoft Copilot in Dynamics 365 Customer Service to its customer service and support agents in 2023. Here, three support agents share their stories about how Copilot helps them be more productive, respond to customers with insight and empathy, and better balance their personal and professional lives. “When a call reaches me, the customer needs reassurance and understanding immediately. I need to absorb a lot of information quickly, and Copilot lets me grasp the details right away.”
